name: configuration-inquiries
description: This prompt is used to inquire about configuration for an application, focusing on their meanings, editability through the standard UI, and recommended values prioritizing privacy and security.
argument-hint: Please provide the configuration you want to inquire about.

# Configuration Inquiries

If a specific configuration value is not provided, or if you are searching for possible configuration values, ask the user which value they would like to set or search for.

1. Explain the meaning and effect of the configuration value.
2. Provide the recommended value prioritizing Privacy and Security, and the reason for it.
